title: An Analytical Framework for a Multi-Particle Oja Flow
summary: We develop an analytical framework for studying a family of interacting particle systems that we refer to as the multi-particle Oja flow. The common interaction structure underlying this family arises in a variety of applications, including higher-order synchronization models, opinion dynamics, and self-attention dynamics derived from Transformer architectures, motivating a unified mathematical framework for their analysis.
